paite: Huai khit in i kihei ua, Bashan lampi ah i paitou uhi. Bashan kumpipa Og leh ami tengteng Edrei ah ei dou ding in ahong kuan uhi.
heading: Israel In Kumpipa Og Azou / (Nam 21.31-35)

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Amah lau ke'n, amah leh ami tengteng leh agam na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon tung a na hih bang in amah tung ah na hih ding," achi hi.
TOUPA i Pathian in Bashan kumpipa Og leng, ami tengteng toh i khut ah hon pia hi. Huchi in khat lel leng hawi lou in i that vek uhi.
Huai lai in akhua tengteng kho sawmguk, Argob gambup a Bashan kumpipa Og gam tengteng i la vek ua, i laksak louh khua khat lel leng a-om kei hi.
Hiai khua tengteng kulh sang pipi, kongpi leh kalhna nei chiat ahi a, kulh nei lou khua tampi sim louh in leng.
Heshbon kumpipa Sihon tung a i hih bang in khua a pasal tengteng, numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh tan in i hihmang sipsip uhi.
Himahleh ganta tengteng leh khua a gallak a i lak thilte ei a tuam ding in i la uhi.
Huai lai in Jordan gal a om Amorte kumpipa nihte a pan Arnon Phaizang a pan Hermon tang pha in gam i la uhi.
Sidonte'n Hermon tuh Sirion achi ua, Amorte'n ahihleh Senir achi uhi.
Phaigam a khua tengteng leh Gilead gam tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng toh, Bashan gam a Og gam a khuate, Salekah leh Endrei tan in i la uhi.

Milian sibangte lak a khosuaksun Bashan kumpipa Og kia ahi a, ngai dih, alupna sik ahi a; Ammon suante khua Rabbah ah tutan in a-om ahi kei maw? Huai lupna mihing tong a teh in adunglam tong kua, availam tong li ahi.
Huai tung in huai gam i luah ua; Arnon Phaizang kiang Aroer a pan Gilead tanggam kimkhat tan in, khua omte toh Reubente leh Gadte ka pia hi.
heading: Jordan Suahlam A Teng Namte / (Nam 32.1-42)

paite: Gilead gam om lai teng leh Og gam Bashan tengteng Manasseh nam kimkhatte ka pia hi, Argob gam tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng Rephaimte gam chih in a-om hi.
Manasseh tapa Jair in Argob gam tengteng Geshurte leh Maakathte gam tan in ala a, Bashan pen, ama min tam in Havothjair asa a, tuni tan in achi lai uh.
Gilead kiang ah Makir ka pia hi.
Reubente leh Gadte bel Gilead a pan Arnon Phaizang, phaizang laitak tan in agam ding un ka pia a; Ammon suante gamgi, Jabok lui tan in.
Atumlam gamgi Arabah a Jordan lui, Kinereth a pan Arabah Tuipi tan, Pisgah mual pang ken nuai apai ahi. Arabah Tuipi, Chi Tuipi ahi.
Huai lai in, TOUPA na Pathian un, "Hiai gam nou a tuam ding in ahon pia hi. Israelte, na unaute uh ma ah na mihangsan tengteng uh kigalthuam in va hohtou sam uhen.
Himahleh, na zite uh leh na taneu chikchikte uh leh na gante uh, ganta na hau uh chih ka thei, na khua uah, ka hon piaksa ah ana om ding uhi.

Nou bang a na unaute uh TOUPA'N galmuang a abawl ma leh TOUPA na Pathian un Jordan gal a gam apiak aluah sam matan uh; huchi in nou a tuam ding ua ka hon piak ah na hong pai nawn ding uh, chi in thu ka hon pia hi.
Huai lai mah in Joshua bel, TOUPA na Pathian un huai kumpipa nihte tung athilhih tengteng na mit in amu vek a; huchi mah bang in na lutna ding gam tengteng tung ah TOUPA'N ahih ding hi.
Amaute lau ke'n; hon doupihpa TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in thu ka pia hi.
"Huai lai mah in TOUPA ka ngen a,
Toupa PATHIAN aw, na sikha kiang ah na thupidan leh na khut hattak na langsak ahi peuhmah ngei hi. Van ah hiam, lei ah hiam na thilhih bang leh na thilhih thupitak bang hihthei pathian kua a-om a?
Hon galkahsak inla, Jordan gal a gam hoihtak, huai tang kilawmtak leh Lebanon hon musak in," ka chi hi.
Himahleh noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, ka thu angaikhe kei a; huchi in TOUPA'N, "Hunta hen, hiai thu ah hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi hi.
"Pisgah tang vum ah va paitou inla, tumlam, mallam, simlam leh suahlam na mit in en inla, en vialvial in. Jordan kan lou ding na hi.
Himahleh Joshua thu pia inla, hanthawn inla, hatsak in. Hiai mipite api galkai dia, na va muhtouh ding gam aluah ding uhi," ahon chi hi.
Huchi in Beth-peor kiangchin a phaizang ah i omta uhi.
